coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 5 ground-truth variable items (40%): JaxMARL/SMAX with a specified common hardware setup, and elapsed training time to a defined performance criterion. Reporting time in seconds rather than minutes is convertible.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses IPPO/SPPO and primarily IQL instead of the required MAPPO and QMIX comparison; QMIX is only optional. Proposes four maps rather than nine selected by excluding maps with more than 10 units. Defines normalized score using random-baseline subtraction and an optionally observed ceiling, rather than score divided by the scenario maximum.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits both expected findings: PPO trains 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios through greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
